name: Should I repair drywall texture myself or hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Should I repair drywall texture myself or hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding between DIY and professional repair depends on the extent of the damage and your skill level. Small, simple holes or minor cracks on smooth walls might be manageable for a homeowner. However, matching existing textures, especially orange peel or knockdown, is challenging and often requires specialized tools and expertise to achieve a seamless finish. A professional ensures a high-quality, invisible repair, saving you time and potential frustration from visible amateur patches. For significant damage or texture matching, hiring a professional is usually recommended.
acceptedAnswer.description: For small, simple repairs, DIY is possible. However, matching textures or significant damage usually requires professional expertise for a seamless result.
